title: The Effects of Zinc Fertilization on Cadmium Concentration in Wheat Grain
notes: This paper examines the effect of Zn fertilization on CADMIUM concentration in wheat grain. It does NOT report grain Zn concentration. The dependent variable is Cd (mg/kg) in grain, not Zn. Therefore no Zn biofortification observations can be extracted for the Hui 2023 meta-analysis.
